summary: Gorax showcases end-game Temporal Vortex teams used by top veteran players, achieving scores up to 74+ billion damage. The video breaks down two main end-game setups: a single-target Dauntless team and an AoE Toxin team. Detailed guidance is provided for hero stat priorities, exclusive artifacts, key gear sets like Puppeteer for 18-second cooldown reduction, and exact ultimate skill timing sequences.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Requires high ATK, 100% Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and low Attack Interval via Attack Speed runes.

heroes.name: Kurvida
heroes.note: Built with Witch's Remains artifact to apply Lightning Vulnerability and supportive gear to boost team damage.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: Uses Arbiter's Pendant artifact; prioritize ATK, Crit Rate, and Crit Damage while ensuring her ATK is lower than Guinavivre's.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Equipped with Angelic Alliance artifact and high Accuracy to reliably apply debuffs while stacking HP.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.note: Built with Puppeteer set to lower ultimate cooldown to match 18s boss rotations and extend debuffs.

heroes.name: Stegamoffyn
heroes.note: Uses Misty Conch artifact to stack debuffs and relies on high ATK to scale his reworked healing.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Uses Dragonbone Catalyst artifact for a 25% damage boost; build high HP and DEF for survivability.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Uses Statue of the Serpent Deity artifact; stack Enlightenment and ATK, skipping Accuracy if paired with Twitch's Accuracy-sharing gear.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Equipped with Ilhuya's Fang artifact and Bone Resonance set with maxed Accuracy to share Accuracy with the team.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Built with Shell of Gilded Doom artifact and Puppeteer set for 18s rotation tuning; passive ignores enemy resistance.

teams.note: Single-target Dauntless team tuned for an 18-second skill rotation.
AoE Toxin team capitalizing on minion/egg spawns and accuracy-sharing mechanics.

meta_changes: Late-game seasons (S8) require two distinct teams for Temporal Vortex instead of one.
Child of Chaos replaces Reytah in high-end Toxin Temporal Vortex teams.
tips: Set ultimate skill recast timings to an 18-second rotation to sync with boss skill patterns.
Use a 3-piece Puppeteer gear set on support heroes to reduce 20s ultimate cooldowns down to 18s.
In the Dauntless sequence, cast Nastjenka's ultimate first, followed by Kurvida for Lightning Vulnerability, and then Guinavivre.
Position Guinavivre adjacent to allies wearing Everburning Netherfire gear to maximize shared ATK bonuses.
